title: Query Usage Record
description: Canonical record accepted by jdbc-mcp-server usage catalog ingestion. Source adapters should emit this shape regardless of their native input format.

schemaVersion.description: Canonical query-usage record schema version. Omit or set to 1 for the current format.

dataSource.description: Logical database identifier scoping this query. Must be stable across imports and must not contain '/' or '#'.

businessLabel.description: Short human-facing label of this query.

businessDomain.description: Business domain or area for grouping.

sql.description: SQL text. Named (:name) or positional (?) bindings are supported. Parse failures are stored instead of rejecting the record.

parameters.description: Query parameters with optional business descriptions.

outputs.description: Output columns of the query and their optional business meaning.

fieldUsages.description: Where and how output fields are used by the consuming artifact.

sourceMeta.description: Arbitrary adapter-provided JSON preserved for audit/provenance.

kind.description: Free source classifier, for example 'bi-publisher-report', 'java-dao', 'dashboard', or 'manual'. This is intentionally not an enum.

path.description: Stable source identifier. It may be a file path, URL, repository path, dashboard id, or adapter-defined id. Must not contain '#'.

unit.description: Sub-unit inside the source: dataset name, DAO method, dashboard panel id, etc. Must not contain '/' or '#'.

alias.description: Output alias as it appears in the SELECT list.

sourceExpression.description: Original SQL expression that produced this output.

output.description: Alias from outputs[]. May be omitted when the usage is not tied to a single output.

businessObject.description: Business object, area, screen, report section, or other adapter-defined grouping.

headers.description: Nearby labels/headings from the consuming artifact.

kind.description: Where the value is rendered or consumed: template-field, ui-label, dashboard-widget, excel-cell, etc. This is intentionally not an enum.
